purpose: Blueprint for a new quality gate; it does not modify or reinterpret quality v1.

suite_geometry.disjointness: Separate generated inputs, expected outputs, identifiers, and content hashes. Generate and seal holdout only after development calibration and policy selection; do not inspect holdout responses during development.

contract_repairs.tool_call: Embed the exact JSON schema and required argument spelling in every prompt; score parsed objects exactly after transport normalization only.
contract_repairs.coding: Allow exactly one whole-response fenced Python block or bare Python, reject prose and non-Python fences, then run a category-specific executable oracle and adversarial mutations.
contract_repairs.long_context_retrieval: State 'return only the value' and use values whose distractor/key mutations prove the scorer rejects wrong values.
contract_repairs.multi_turn_continuation: Give an explicit output-format instruction and include order, omission, and unrelated-turn mutation controls.
contract_repairs.teacher_forced_loss: Use twelve fixed synthetic sequences. On development only, measure intended BF16 controls across three cold-start captures, then freeze each sequence ceiling as the maximum observed control mean NLL plus a preregistered 5% tolerance before sealing holdout.
contract_repairs.serving_correctness: Supply the exact required JSON schema in the prompt; retain two deterministic repetitions and reject type, field, and truncation mutations.

transport_policy.allowed: Bare output or one complete language-matched fenced block with no leading/trailing prose.
transport_policy.evidence: Retain raw response bytes, normalized output bytes, transform decision, and hashes for each case.

eligibility_policy_to_freeze_after_devel.absolute_control: All critical category point scores must be at least 5/6 and no category may be zero; report exact binomial intervals rather than treating six cases as a certification.
eligibility_policy_to_freeze_after_devel.paired_awq: On the untouched holdout, retain category-stratified paired bootstrap intervals and reject any critical-category point regression over 1/6 or overall lower confidence bound below -0.05.
eligibility_policy_to_freeze_after_devel.nll: Reject missing runtime input-token logprobs, token-sequence hash mismatches, or any candidate sequence above its frozen calibrated ceiling.

promotion_rule: A passing new gate supports only the specified model revision, transport policy, workload-independent capability screen, and exact representation pair. It does not repair V1 or establish provider equivalence.
